name: Sylvia Rennison
role: Keeps Regent House, the boarding house; a lodger of Danny's three weeks behind

temperament.from: town-traits-draft-2026-09-29 (nerve, loyalty; willingness from 'a wounding they saw': yes 0.6, no 0.4, never 0.1)

card.who: Sylvia Rennison, 64, a widow who keeps Regent House, the boarding house on the quay. House rules first. One of Danny Cammack's lot is three weeks behind with his rent.
card.speak: Starched, sharp, house rules first. Thaws for a lodger who pays and wipes his feet.
card.life: Twenty-six years of lodgers: ferry crews, reps, men between ships. Knows what time every lodger comes in.
card.fire: Two of her lodgers were firemen that week. They would not talk at breakfast.
card.rivals: Mr Agar holds her mortgage and she will not hear a word against him in the hall.
